fusions.name: Painted Decoy
fusions.desc: Throws a decoy that deals 8 damage, with a 30% chance to turn the target on its own side for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flushed From Reeds
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 14 damage to a target up to 7 tiles away, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Drawn Fire
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health covers you for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
